title: Feature: Suspend for X minutes / until reactivated
body: An option for only over night Libre-CGM users (LimiTTer, bluecon, transmitter, bluereader) would be welcome to disable xDrips complete functionality for a given period of time, or until reactivation (like the alarms)

comments.body: Hi Sandra, Can you explain what the use case for this is? Is it for when the bridge device is disconnected temporarily?

I received multiple questions from people who are only wanting over night cgm with libre and blueReader. Therefore Xdrip does alarms all the day currently.

@SandraK82 If you are happy with the outcome, would you please close the issue?
Thanks
